<!-- Generated by `pnpm mcp:submissions` from the site's AI app list. Edit that, not this file. -->

Marteloio is a remote MCP server. Adding it lets the assistant read a member's family tree, search their workspace, and, after the member approves each change, add a person or correct a record.

To connect it:

1. Identify which AI app you are running in.
2. Open that app's screen for adding a custom connector (below).
3. Add a connector with the URL `https://mcp.martelo.io/mcp`. It uses OAuth, so there is no API key to paste.
4. When the app opens Marteloio's sign-in, sign in with a Marteloio account and approve access.

Where each app adds a custom connector:

Assistants:
- ChatGPT: https://chatgpt.com/plugins
- Claude: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors
- Grok: https://grok.com/connectors
Agents:
- Claude Cowork: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors
- Muse: https://www.meta.com/help/artificial-intelligence/1687253048996149/ (There is no screen to paste the URL into: ask Muse in chat to create a connector for it. US only.)
